title: Schedule metrics guide
purpose: Explain the practical review bands, calculations, evidence coverage and score used by the Schedule Metrics tab.
introduction:
Score = average of the ten checks' points × 100. Each check earns 1 point at its target, falling evenly to 0 at its limit; all checks weigh the same.
Score colour: green ≥95%, amber ≥75%, red <75%. Scroll for each metric's target, limit and scope.
Activity lists: right-click an update in the counts table > Drill through > Missing Predecessor or Missing Successor.

reading_notes.title: Core activity population
reading_notes.text: Unless a row says otherwise, core activity checks use incomplete task-dependent and resource-dependent activities. Completed activities, milestones, level-of-effort activities and WBS summaries are excluded. Unscheduled work is included. Project and WBS selections, datalake exclusions and access restrictions are retained.

reading_notes.title: Review bands and evidence coverage
reading_notes.text: For the ten scored checks, green is at target, amber is between target and limit and red is at or past the limit; points fall evenly between target and limit. Percentages use records with usable inputs; excluded inputs are disclosed separately, so a priority result stays red when evidence is partial. A check with nothing to count shows 0%; grey means no valid project and update is selected. Missing required dates count as defects.

reading_notes.title: Updates and trend lines
reading_notes.text: Gauges show the selected snapshot. Trends show each available snapshot through the selected cutoff; multiple selected dates use their latest date for core histories. If the selected project has no snapshot at the cutoff, current gauges can be N/A while earlier history remains visible. Each counts-table row refers to its own update; counts must not be added across updates.

reading_notes.title: Baseline and detail scope
reading_notes.text: Baseline coverage uses the whole selected project and programme, including its completed activities, independently of the WBS and activity-status selections. Baseline coverage matches activity codes to the latest BL-tagged snapshot on or before the selected update, or falls back to the earliest loaded snapshot when no BL file exists. Table 04 is a derived earliest-snapshot subset, not an independent baseline. Invalid BL filename provenance makes baseline coverage 0%; repeated or blank activity codes are disclosed in its tooltip, not penalised.

reading_notes.title: Reading counts beside percentages
reading_notes.text: A grid count shows the number of flagged activities or relationships; the corresponding percentage divides that count by the population described here. Unknown inputs can reduce a percentage denominator without changing the number of remaining activities. Missing predecessor and successor counts can overlap; the combined logic check counts each activity only once.

reading_notes.title: Units and source conventions
reading_notes.text: Total float is already in working days; no conversion is applied. PR_FS1 is a user-confirmed FS alias and imported relationship rows are retained without deduplication.

reading_notes.title: Activity drill-through
reading_notes.text: Activity details: in the counts table, right-click an update and select Drill through > Missing Predecessor or Missing Successor.

rows.meaning: Activities with no predecessor, no successor, or neither.
rows.calculation: Activities missing either end / core activities. Each activity counted once.
rows.population: Core activities: incomplete task- and resource-dependent activities. Excludes milestones, LOE, WBS summaries and completed work.
rows.limitations: Pred. and Succ. counts overlap. Drill through from the counts table to list activities.
rows.score_note: 1 point at ≤5%, falling evenly to 0 at 10%.

rows.calculation: Relationships with lag < 0 / relationships with a known lag.
rows.limitations: Counts relationships, not activities. Missing lag excluded.
rows.score_note: 1 point at 0%, falling evenly to 0 at 1%.

rows.meaning: Relationships with a waiting period of more than 5 working days.
rows.calculation: Relationships with lag > 5 days / relationships with a known lag.
rows.limitations: Short lags (5 days or less), mostly on SS/FF overlap pairs, are not counted; overlap use is assessed through FS relationships. Missing lag excluded.
rows.score_note: 1 point at ≤5%, falling evenly to 0 at 10%.

related_grid_counts.label: Lags >5d
related_grid_counts.meaning: Number of eligible relationships with lag over 5 working days.

rows.meaning: Share of relationships that are finish-to-start.
rows.calculation: FS relationships (incl. PR_FS1) / relationships with a recognised FS, SS, FF or SF type.
rows.limitations: Unknown types excluded. FS and FS1 rows are not deduplicated.
rows.score_note: 1 point at ≥90%, falling evenly to 0 at 80%.

rows.meaning: Activities whose primary constraint fixes or caps their dates.
rows.calculation: Activities with a restrictive primary constraint / core activities with a known or blank constraint.
rows.limitations: Counted: CS_MSO, CS_MSOB, CS_MEO, CS_MEOB, CS_MANDSTART, CS_MANDFIN. Unknown codes excluded.
rows.score_note: 1 point at ≤5%, falling evenly to 0 at 10%.

related_grid_counts.label: Restrictive primary
related_grid_counts.meaning: Number of activities with a counted restrictive primary constraint.

rows.meaning: In-progress activities that started before their logic allowed.
rows.calculation: In-progress activities with an FS predecessor not finished, or an SS predecessor not started / in-progress activities.
rows.population: In-progress task- and resource-dependent activities. LOE and WBS predecessors are ignored.
rows.limitations: Shows 0% until work is in progress. Fix by progressing the predecessor or correcting the logic.
rows.score_note: 1 point at 0%, falling evenly to 0 at 10%.

related_grid_counts.label: Out of seq.
related_grid_counts.meaning: Number of in-progress activities out of sequence.

rows.meaning: Activities forecast to miss a required date (total float below zero).
rows.calculation: Activities with total float < 0 / core activities with known float.
rows.limitations: Any negative float counts, however small. Missing float excluded.
rows.score_note: 1 point at 0%, falling evenly to 0 at 5%.

related_grid_counts.label: Float <0
related_grid_counts.meaning: Number of eligible activities with negative total float.

rows.meaning: Activities with more than 44 working days still to perform.
rows.calculation: Activities with remaining duration > 44d / core activities with known, non-negative remaining duration.
rows.limitations: Uses remaining, not original, duration. Exactly 44d is not flagged.
rows.score_note: 1 point at ≤5%, falling evenly to 0 at 10%.

related_grid_counts.label: Rem. duration >44d
related_grid_counts.meaning: Number of eligible activities with remaining duration above 44 working days.

rows.meaning: Activities with a missing required date, or a date inconsistent with the data date or status.
rows.calculation: Activities and milestones failing any date rule / all eligible activities and milestones. Each counted once.
rows.population: Task- and resource-dependent activities and milestones in all statuses. Excludes LOE and WBS summaries.
rows.limitations: Rules: future actuals, overdue forecasts, actual finish vs status, missing data date, unknown status, finish before start. Milestones need only their relevant date. Missing dates count as defects.
rows.score_note: 1 point at 0%, falling evenly to 0 at 1%.

rows.meaning: Share of current activities that have a dated baseline match.
rows.calculation: Current activities matched to a baseline activity with a Finish / all current activities.
rows.population: Whole project, all statuses, against the latest BL baseline file up to the selected update (or the earliest loaded update when no BL file exists).
rows.limitations: Not changed by WBS selection. 0% if a BL filename tag is invalid; repeated codes are disclosed, not penalised. New or renumbered activities lower coverage until the next re-baseline.
rows.score_note: 1 point at ≥90%, falling evenly to 0 at 60%.

related_grid_counts.label: Baseline coverage (project)
related_grid_counts.meaning: The same whole-project coverage percentage shown in the counts grid.

reading_legend:
Check colours: green = at target (full point); amber = between target and limit (part point); red = at or past the limit (no point); grey = no valid selection.
Partial inputs are a separate coverage warning: hover for known/excluded records.
